use: Shown sealed; sipped from an already-opened packet (opening happens off screen, never torn on camera).

positive_relative_scale_prompt: A carton whose front is about as wide as an adult palm, resting fully on one open palm, with its upright front slightly taller than it is wide and its depth visibly shallower than its front width. A slim palm-scale flexible stick packet, shorter than the carton height and about as long as the carton front is wide, only slightly wider than an adult thumb pad; its softly filled thickness remains much smaller than its width. Hand contact naturally hides part of the packet body. The selected product reference fixes its package proportions; the original shot fixes hand scale, depth and perspective throughout the edited shot.

reference_input_policy.additional_product_view_policy: Use only the registered references (handheld_photo, opened_packet_hand, carton_views, carton_hand, phone_page, desktop_page). A carton shot sends carton_views + carton_hand together. A phone screen showing the competitor's shopping or landing page sends phone_page; a laptop / desktop screen sends desktop_page. Do not invent or auto-add other product images.

reference_selection_policy.policy: Choose the product FORM and STATE first from real-world use (references/controlled-edit.md §4), then send only what appears: sealed packet held, shown or pulled out -> handheld_photo; packet already opened, drinking, squeezing into water -> opened_packet_hand; any carton -> carton_views + carton_hand (in that order), written with the carton template (references/carton-swap.md). A phone screen that shows the competitor's shopping / landing page -> phone_page; a laptop or desktop screen -> desktop_page (user 2026-11-22), plus the form image of any product held in the same shot.

facts.net_weight_per_packet: 8 g (0.28 oz) as printed on carton and sachet; one formula artwork says 10 g — do not state either number in generated speech
facts.serving_claim_printed: 6785mg per serving; 12-IN-1 HERBAL BLEND; DIETARY SUPPLEMENT

carton.lid: tuck-top flip lid HINGED ALONG THE TOP EDGE OF THE FRONT PANEL (the LYMPHATIC DRAINAGE SUPPORT face). To open, fingers lift the lid edge above the BACK panel (Supplement Facts face) and the lid swings up and over toward the front, ending upright/tilted forward; the white inner side faces the opener and two small side flaps fold out. Sticks stand upright, tightly packed, tops up. (User-confirmed 2026-10-21.)
carton.faces: front = LYMPHATIC DRAINAGE SUPPORT panel; back = Supplement Facts + Why LYMPHLOOP text; sides carry the logo

stick.form: flexible single-use liquid stick sachet, teal film with white yesnap/LymphLoop print
stick.notch: small tear notches on BOTH side edges just below the top seal band (user-confirmed 2026-10-21); the band above the notches is the narrow seal strip
stick.scale_vs_hand: about index-finger length, slightly wider than a thumb pad; lies across an adult palm

physical_state_chain: top_seal_torn (OFF SCREEN only, skipped with a hard cut)
facts.opening: OFF-SCREEN fact only; never staged on camera. One hand holds the sachet upright below the notches; the other pinches the narrow top band and tears it sideways in ONE motion so the WHOLE top strip comes off (never just a corner); the detached strip (~2.5 cm wide, <1 cm tall, silver tear edge) stays pinched in the tearing hand; the opening is a short soft flat slit, never a V/W rip or serrated edge; no liquid or cross-section visible. (User-confirmed 2026-10-21.)
facts.consumption: ONE hand only: it raises the opened end to the lips, lips close around the short opening and the person sips while the head tilts back slightly and the sachet tilts toward horizontal with a light squeeze; the other hand is free; no visible liquid, no pouring, no dropper. (User-confirmed 2026-10-21.)
facts.liquid: pale yellow-green, clear, low viscosity; only ever visible in a cup when the source shot already shows liquid being added to a cup
facts.display_defaults: closed carton standing on its base with one sealed sachet lying flat or leaning against it with real support; sachets never stand upright on their own
never_show: competitor bottle, dropper, pipette, bulb or cap
liquid inside the sachet or an opening cross-section
back-panel Supplement Facts close-ups (AI rewrites small print)
any product view beyond the registered references

the sachet being torn open on screen (user 2026-10-24): show the sealed sachet (handheld_photo) for display, the already-opened sachet (opened_packet_hand) for sipping; a one-take 'pull dropper -> drip' gets a hard cut between the two

items: lid hinge on front-panel top edge; back-panel edge is lifted
whole top strip torn off in one motion
one-handed sip is the natural, authentic action

physical_evidence_local.rule: Real usage clips for the agent only: watch them before writing carton-opening, extraction or sipping actions; the tear clip only explains what happens OFF screen (tearing is never staged on camera). Never upload these files.

known.product: lymphatic drainage liquid herbal extract, 2 fl oz (59 ml)
known.look: amber/brown glass dropper bottle with a ribbed black screw cap and black rubber bulb; cream label with a dark-green band, green leaf logo and the words LYMPHORIA / lymphatic drainage / TRADITIONAL LYMPHATIC SUPPORT and four herb icons (Cleavers, Red Clover, Stillingia, Prickly Ash); glass pipette holding pale amber honey-coloured liquid
hard_cases: bottle gripped in a fist so the label is completely hidden: only the amber glass neck/shoulder, the black cap or the bare amber base show between the fingers
bottle with the cap removed: an open amber glass neck with screw threads, no label visible
the dropper alone, held above a mouth, tongue or cup, with or without a hanging drop
bottle in the background, on a table, in a mirror, or partially out of frame
any amber glass bottle of this shape even when the label text cannot be read
